records.section_heading: Ecology and Community Structure of Some Tropical Reef Algae in Samoa
records.question: According to the section, how do algal communities interact with substrate availability?
records.ground_truth_answer: Algal communities help to control substrate availability and are themselves altered by the types of substrate available.
ground_truth_chunks: Algal communities also help to control substrate availability, and are themselves altered by the types of substrate available.

records.question: How many line transects were established across the intertidal and high subtidal portions of the fringing reefs around Tutuila Island and Aunuu Island?
ground_truth_chunks: As part of a long-term survey and monitoring program, 10 line transects were established across the intertidal and high subtidal portions of the fringing reefs around Tutuila Island and on nearby Aunuu Island, representing a variety of exposures and habitats.
The initial surveys were established in January 1970, and most stations were repeated in July 1970.

records.question: Which algal component is frequently the most significant in shallow reef areas?
records.ground_truth_answer: Turfs are frequently the most significant algal component in shallow reef areas.
ground_truth_chunks: In terms of percent coverage, turfs are frequently the most significant algal component in shallow reef areas.
Extensive turfs were also noted along subtidal channels and on the dead portions of coral heads.

records.question: According to the Discussion, which algal genera may serve an anchoring function within the turf community?
records.ground_truth_answer: Jania, Laurencia, or Hypnea may serve a similar anchoring function.
ground_truth_chunks: The Halimeda provides the only firm attachment in the sand for the Dictyota, the Dictyota alters conditions under the mat in a way that may or may not be beneficial to the Halimeda.
In the turf community, Jania, Laurencia, or Hypnea may serve a similar anchoring function for other algae, or even for the substrate.
